annotations.title: Buy credits with a plain USDC transfer: get a quote (free)

description: FREE, no x402 needed. Returns a quote id and the EXACT USDC amount to send on Base from your address to this service. After sending, call credits_claim with the quote id to receive an ssk_ key. 1 credit = $0.001 of list price (OFAC check 5, chat message 3, chat sweep of 25 messages 50, address check 1, payout list 50).

from.description: The Base address you will send the USDC from (0x + 40 hex). Only a transfer from that address can claim the quote.

pack.description: starter $0.25 (300 credits), team $1 (1,500 credits), ops $5 (9,000 credits). Default team.
